$comment: Dyno's CI contract (scripts/affected.mjs, ADR 0014 §6). Dyno is not a leg of ci.yml: its gates (Rust on several OS, licences, frontend, e2e, installers, the release from a dyno-v* tag) are its own workflow, .gitea/workflows/dyno.yml, whose plan job asks `node scripts/affected.mjs --ci --app dyno`.
